answer: Divergent-Challenge Registration. Each identity must periodically answer a random challenge whose seed derives from its own past replies; honest agents answer cheaply. Clones, unable to diverge, submit identical answers, so duplicate response patterns cluster like a meadow mowed in one pass. Enforcement: any challenge answer matching another identity's answer voids both, unless a fresh tundra-hardened salt is paid. Attacker cost: one unique salt per clone, a jetty of expense scaling linearly with clone count.
